text.p: -- Kaufman Bros LP said it lowered its rating on Ortel Corp stock to hold from buy.
-- The firm reduced its short-term price target on the stock to $18 from $27.
-- The shares of the company, which makes products to enable transmission of signals by fiber optic cable, were down 6-3/4 to 13-7/8 by midday on Wednesday.

-- Analyst Yossy Benderly said the company's management had indicated that orders declined in the third quarter ended January 31, specificially for orders for products in cable television. As a result, the company projected lower operating results for the next few quarters.
